name: Create a bold duotone cover with left-aligned uppercase headline
query: Create a full-width hiking promotion cover pattern with a duotone image treatment, very large left-aligned uppercase heading, and one outlined Explore button.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm image asset, theme presets, text domain, title, slug, and categories
Step 2: Use a full-width Cover block with image, dim/duotone treatment, and generous padding
Step 3: Use a short large uppercase heading with tight line-height and left alignment
Step 4: Add an action-specific outlined CTA with enough spacing from the heading
Step 5: Use theme presets/block attributes for colors, spacing, and typography
Step 6: Escape and translate all visible strings
Step 7: Verify contrast and responsive fit for oversized text
success_criteria: Cover block uses image plus dim/duotone treatment for a strong poster feel
Heading is large, left-aligned, uppercase, and readable without clipping
CTA label is specific and not vague
Uses theme presets or documented color choices rather than arbitrary unverified values
No custom CSS classes, inline style tags, scripts, or runtime PHP
All strings are escaped and internationalized
Verification includes mobile text fit and contrast
